About the Black Girls Do Bike NYC Weekend Rides group ride

Black Girls Do Bike NYC Weekend Rides is a road and social group ride in New York, NY. It rolls some Saturdays and Sundays at 10:00 am from Varies. Beginner rides meet at Trek Bicycle Upper West Side (72nd St).

The New York chapter of Black Girls Do Bike. It runs weekend rides for women of color and friends, from short beginner laps in Central Park to long training days. 2026 rides included beginner rides from the Upper West Side, a Bronx River Greenway social ride and a pier ride. Check Eventbrite or the Facebook group for the next one.
